full_judgment: 6. Being aggrieved the plaintiff preferred the aforementioned second appeal therefrom to the High Court Division. A Single Bench of the said Court, by its judgment and decree dated 23 January, 1992, set aside the said appellate judgment of reversal and restored that of the trial Court on the view that the judgment of the lower appellate Court suffered from errors of law.
